learning_outcomes.text: Students' perspective, understanding, and knowledge of nature and the environment develop.
Students can prepare themselves for sustainable living.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION: Meaning and importance of the topic. Basic components and general conditions of the topic.
NATURE AND UNIVERSE. Open and closed systems. Continuity.
HUMAN AND ENVIRONMENT. ANTHROPOLOGICAL IMPACT MEASUREMENTS AND EVALUATIONS.
THE LAST DAY OF THE ENVIRONMENT.
ENVIRONMENTAL PSYCHOLOGY, WHAT IS IT ACTUALLY?
